ryan: @sarah if auto-evac already started, do we have enough spare capacity in other pools? Can we re-route non-enterprise traffic?

ops-rotations-bot: @ryan assigned to followup (oncall change) for next shift starting in 30m.

alex: quick command to drain nodes (for reference): ```bash
# cordon + drain pods that match bad-pod-label
kubectl cordon node/gpu-node-22 -n inference
kubectl drain node/gpu-node-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference
```
sarah: executed drain on gpu-node-22 and gpu-node-24, restarting schedulers for those pods. KV cache warmed for replacements but takes ~45s to refill. Latency P95 dropping from 2.3s -> 1.1s for model=redwood-llama-13b.
